Hi Alex / Priya,

Great to meet earlier. Quick follow-up with the two parallel paths we discussed so procurement can choose the fastest route: 

A) Pilot start (recommended for speed):
- Submit a PO for the pilot month amount in the attached pricing quote. Finance will invoice Net-30 on receipt of PO and we can turn on the account within 24-48 hours.
- This avoids waiting for Marketplace approval and gives you quick access to the hosted API.

B) AWS Marketplace (preferred for long-term):
- Redwood is an active AWS Marketplace seller and supports consolidated billing and private offers. If you want marketplace invoicing for the pilot and beyond, we can initiate the private offer flow with AWS.
- Typical private-offer timelines are 3-6 weeks depending on AWS review and your internal approvals.

Attachments included: redwood-pricing-quote.pdf, marketplace-onboarding-checklist.xlsx, redwood-terms-v1.1.docx, SOC2-Type2-summary.pdf.

Proposed next step: 30-min procurement sync on Tue 18 Aug at 10:00am PT to confirm path and collect PO info if you choose the pilot route. Marissa (cc) will join to cover marketplace intake.
